messages:
Avery: Heads up — privacy got a DSAR delete request for user+eu@redwood.example. No legal hold. Concern: archived nightly snapshots and cold tape backups. We rotated KMS key in feb; need to confirm if old key material available.
Rina: Was the request auto-verified? Any PII scope details?
Avery: Automated verifier OK. Affects embeddings and some audit entries where email present in metadata.
Sam: Action plan: 1) inventory snapshots referencing old key. 2) create ephemeral erasure role with 3hr TTL. 3) dry-run enumerate + audit-log only. 4) if decryption needed, open infra ticket for rewrap access. 5) execute scrub and emit deletion receipt. If any cold backups are immutable, file a retention-exception and notify legal/privacy.
infra-bot: Scan result: 1 embedding index, 1 s3 snapshot, 1 glacier archive object found. Snapshot meta: snap-20240205 -> key-feb-2023. Archive object arn:aws:s3:::archives/prod/2023-02-01.tar.gz
Rina: If archive is glacier-deep, we likely can't rewrite; need retention-exception. Sam: I'll provision ephemeral role and run dry-run. Avery: Please add audit assertions: actor, timestamp, preimage-hash, request_id, target-paths. We'll include dry-run logs in the privacy ticket.
infra-bot: KMS log: key-feb-2023 rotated but previous version retained with rewrap metadata. Decrypt feasible with infra assistance.
Avery: OK, Sam start dry-run and I'll open infra ticket listing snap + archive. If infra can't decrypt archive within 48h, we'll start retention-exception process and draft comms to the requestor.
